statement: Let (X, ∆) be a normal projective complex klt pair of dimension four, with effective rational boundary, and put D = KX + ∆. Suppose D is pseudoeffective and N is a nef Q-Cartier divisor. If both D and D + N satisfy the metric condition (4.1) and χ(X, OX) ̸= 0, then some rational t0 > 0 satisfies κ(X, D + tN) ≥ 0 for every rational t ∈ [0, t0].
